author: Isaac Backus
title_en: Family Prayer Not to Be Neglected
title_tet: Orasaun Família Nian La Bele Neglijénsia
subtitle_en: Reviving Daily Household Worship and Seeking the Lord Together
subtitle_tet: Hamoris Fali Adorasaun Família Nian Loron-Loron no Buka Na'i Hamutuk

cards.section_heading_tet: Introdusaun - Hamoris Fali Adorasaun Família Nian
cards.scripture_en: "That your prayers be not hindered" (1 Pet 3:7).
cards.scripture_tet: "Atu imi-nia orasaun sira la hetan impedidu" (1 Pedro 3:7).
cards.body_en: That your prayers be not hindered (1 Peter 3:7). New England has been a place famous for religion in general, and for family worship in particular; but lately, the neglect of this and other religious duties has evidently been growing among us. I humbly offer these considerations to revive the daily practice of family prayer, that households may seek the Lord continuously together.
cards.body_tet: Atu imi-nia orasaun sira la hetan impedidu (1 Pedro 3:7). New England sai ona fatin ida ne'ebé famozu ba relijiaun iha jerál, no ba adorasaun família nian espesialmente; maibé foin lalais ne'e, neglijénsia ba ida-ne'e no devér relijiozu seluk sira aumenta ho klaru iha ita-nia leet. Ha'u ho haraik-aan oferese konsiderasaun sira-ne'e atu hamoris fali prátika loron-loron orasaun família nian, atu família sira bele buka Na'i nafatin hamutuk.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Daily family prayer is a vital biblical duty that keeps prayers from being hindered and invites God's blessing into the home.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Orasaun família nian loron-loron mak devér bíbliku importante ne'ebé evita orasaun hetan impedidu no konvida bensaun Maromak nian ba uma.

cards.section_heading_en: Scripture Evidence for Daily Family Prayer
cards.section_heading_tet: Evidénsia Eskritura Nian Ba Orasaun Família Nian Loron-Loron
cards.scripture_en: "Our Father which art in heaven... Give us this day our daily bread" (Matt 6:9, 11).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ami-nia Aman ne'ebé iha lalehan... Fó mai ami ohin ami-nia ai-han loron-loron nian" (Mateus 6:9, 11).
cards.body_en: Our relation to God as His children loudly declares the importance of daily prayer. Christ taught us to pray, Our Father which art in heaven... Give us this day our daily bread (Mat 6:9, 11). Notice that He says Our Father (social prayer) and Give us THIS DAY (daily prayer). Because we have not only personal but also family needs and mercies, our daily dependence on God requires daily family worship.
cards.body_tet: Ita-nia relasaun ho Maromak nu'udar Ninia oan sira deklara ho lian maka'as importánsia orasaun loron-loron nian. Kristu hanorin ita atu harohan, Ami-nia Aman ne'ebé iha lalehan... Fó mai ami ohin ami-nia ai-han loron-loron nian (Mateus 6:9, 11). Repara katak Nia dehan Ami-nia Aman (orasaun hamutuk) no Fó mai ami OHIN (orasaun loron-loron). Tanba ita iha la'ós de'it nesesidade no bensaun pesoál maibé mós família nian, ita-nia dependénsia loron-loron ba Maromak ezije adorasaun família nian loron-loron.
cards.key_takeaway_en: The Lord's Prayer teaches us to pray together ('Our Father') daily ('this day') for shared household needs and mercies.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Orasaun Na'i nian hanorin ita atu harohan hamutuk ('Ami-nia Aman') loron-loron ('ohin') ba nesesidade no bensaun família nian.

cards.section_heading_en: Old & New Testament Examples of Household Worship
cards.section_heading_tet: Ezemplu Sira Testamentu Tuan no Foun Kona-Ba Adorasaun Família
cards.scripture_en: "As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD" (Josh 24:15).
cards.scripture_tet: "Maibé ha'u no ha'u-nia uma-laran, ami sei serbí NA'I" (Josué 24:15).
cards.body_en: Patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob practiced calling on the name of the Lord wherever their families dwelt. Joshua resolved: As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD (Jos 24:15). David returned from public worship to bless his household (2 Sam 6:20). And our Savior Himself practiced daily prayer and giving of thanks with His spiritual family, the disciples.
cards.body_tet: Patriarka sira Abraão, Izabel no Jacob hala'o prátika bolu Na'i nia naran iha fatin hotu ne'ebé sira-nia família hela. Josué rezolve: Maibé ha'u no ha'u-nia uma-laran, ami sei serbí NA'I (Josué 24:15). David fila husi adorasaun públiku atu haraik bensaun ba ninia uma-laran (2 Samuel 6:20). No ita-nia Salvador rasik hala'o orasaun loron-loron no fó agradesimentu hamutuk ho Ninia família espirituál, dixípulu sira.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Godly leaders throughout Scripture—patriarchs, Joshua, David, and Christ Himself—led their households in prayer and worship.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Líder sira ne'ebé tauk Maromak iha Eskritura tomak—patriarka sira, Josué, David no Kristu rasik—lori sira-nia uma-laran iha orasaun no adorasaun.

cards.section_heading_tet: Família Jentiu Sira vs. Família Sira Ne'ebé Harohan
cards.scripture_en: "Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name" (Jer 10:25).
cards.scripture_tet: "Fakar Ó-nia hirus ba jentiu sira ne'ebé la hatene Ó, no ba família sira ne'ebé la bolu Ó-nia naran" (Jeremias 10:25).
cards.body_en: The prophet Jeremiah distinguishes those who know not God by this characteristic: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name (Jer 10:25). A prayerless family, whatever its profession, bears the scriptural mark of a heathen family. While outward morality alone does not save, a family that neglects calling on God lives in practical ungodliness.
cards.body_tet: Profeta Jeremias haketak sira ne'ebé la hatene Maromak liuhosi karakterístika ida-ne'e: Fakar Ó-nia hirus ba jentiu sira ne'ebé la hatene Ó, no ba família sira ne'ebé la bolu Ó-nia naran (Jeremias 10:25). Família ida ne'ebé la harohan, maski dehan saida de'it, lori marka bíbliku husi família jentiu ida. Enkuantu moralidade iha li'ur mesak la salva, família ida ne'ebé neglijénsia bolu Maromak moris iha impiedade prátika.
cards.key_takeaway_en: A household that neglects calling on God's name shows practical ungodliness, whereas family prayer marks a God-fearing home.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Uma-laran ida ne'ebé neglijénsia bolu Maromak nia naran hatudu impiedade prátika, enkuantu orasaun família marka uma ne'ebé tauk Maromak.

cards.scripture_en: "By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually" (Heb 13:15).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tanba ne'e liuhosi Nia, husik ita oferese sakrifísiu louvór nian ba Maromak nafatin" (Ebreu 13:15).
cards.body_en: Some plead there is no express command for family prayer. But if Christ commands us to pray Our Father... Give us this day our daily bread, if we are commanded to offer praise continually (Heb 13:15), if husbands and wives must walk so that their prayers be not hindered (1 Pet 3:7), and if missing prayer marks a heathen family—what more could mortal man desire to prove that God requires daily family worship?
cards.body_tet: Balun alega katak la iha mandamentu esplísitu ba orasaun família nian. Maibé se Kristu haruka ita atu harohan Ami-nia Aman... Fó mai ami ohin ami-nia ai-han loron-loron nian, se ita hetan mandamentu atu oferese louvór nafatin (Ebreu 13:15), se la'en no feen tenke la'o atu sira-nia orasaun la hetan impedidu (1 Pedro 3:7), no se falta orasaun marka família jentiu ida—saida tan mak ema mortal bele hakarak atu prova katak Maromak ezije adorasaun família nian loron-loron?
cards.key_takeaway_en: Scripture's commands for daily shared prayer, continual praise, and unhindered prayers clearly establish family worship.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Mandamentu Eskritura nian ba orasaun hamutuk loron-loron, louvór nafatin no orasaun sem impedidu estabelese ho klaru adorasaun família.

cards.scripture_en: "Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy" (Heb 4:16).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tanba ne'e husik ita mai ho brani ba tronu grasa nian, atu ita bele hetan laran-sadia" (Ebreu 4:16).
cards.body_en: Others object that they have no inclination or freedom of mind to pray, and to pray without feeling would be bondage. Dreadful excuse! This makes your own inclination the rule instead of God’s command. Rising corruptions and a cold heart are an errand to drive you TO God for mercy, not an excuse to stay away from Him!
cards.body_tet: Seluk kontra katak sira la iha vontade ka liberdade hanoin atu harohan, no harohan sein sentidu sei sai escravidaun. Deskulpa todan tebes! Ida-ne'e halo ó-nia vontade rasik sai regra duké mandamentu Maromak nian. Korrupsaun ne'ebé sa'e no fuan malirin mak razaun ida atu lori ó BA Maromak ba laran-sadia, la'ós deskulpa atu hela sees husi Nia!
cards.key_takeaway_en: A cold heart or lack of feeling is a reason to seek God's mercy in prayer, not an excuse to neglect Him.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fuan malirin ka falta sentidu mak razaun atu buka laran-sadia Maromak nian iha orasaun, la'ós deskulpa atu neglijénsia Nia.

cards.scripture_en: "Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven" (Matt 5:3).
cards.scripture_tet: "Bensaun ba sira ne'ebé kiak iha espíritu: tanba sira-nian mak reinu lalehan nian" (Mateus 5:3).
cards.body_en: Some argue that daily family prayer leads people to rely on their own works. On the contrary! True prayer is a needy beggar coming to God for alms, not a merchant bringing goods to trade. The more destitute the beggar feels, the more incessant his cry. To refrain from prayer because you feel unworthy springs from hidden self-righteous pride that only wants to come when it has something good to bring.
cards.body_tet: Balun argumenta katak orasaun família nian loron-loron lori ema atu depende ba sira-nia hahalok rasik. Kontráriu! Orasaun loos mak ema kiak ne'ebé presiza mai ba Maromak ba esmola, la'ós merkadoria-na'in ne'ebé lori sasán atu troka. Liu-husi kiak ne'ebé ema kiak sente, liután ninia halerik la para. Hsees husi orasaun tanba sente la merese mai husi orgulhu justisa aan rasik ne'ebé subar, ne'ebé hakarak mai de'it bainhira iha buat di'ak atu lori.
cards.key_takeaway_en: True prayer is a needy beggar asking grace from God, exposing pride rather than building self-righteousness.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Orasaun loos mak ema kiak ne'ebé husu grasa husi Maromak, hodi hatudu sai orgulhu duké hariis justisa aan rasik.

cards.scripture_en: "As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD" (Josh 24:15).
cards.scripture_tet: "Maibé ha'u no ha'u-nia uma-laran, ami sei serbí NA'I" (Josué 24:15).
cards.body_en: Dear heads of families, delay no longer! As Joshua declared, settle it today: As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD. Content not yourselves with private prayer alone; let your household gather morning and evening. And to young people: learn the sweetness of traveling through the world with God from your youth, for in His presence is fullness of joy.
cards.body_tet: Xefe família sira doben, keta demora tan! Hanesan Josué deklara, rezolve ohin: Maibé ha'u no ha'u-nia uma-laran, ami sei serbí NA'I. Keta kontente de'it ho orasaun privadu; husik ó-nia uma-laran halibur dadeer no kalan. No ba joven sira: aprende midar husi la'o iha mundu hamutuk ho Maromak husi ó-nia tempu joven, tanba iha Ninia prezensa iha ksolok nakonu.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Heads of households should gather their families morning and evening to serve the Lord together from youth.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Xefe uma-laran sira tenke halibur sira-nia família dadeer no kalan atu serbí Na'i hamutuk husi tempu joven.
